headline: Technology spending varies across sectors while AI investments rise and cost pressures tighten in media.
summary: Media firms show strong revenue growth but are cutting costs and tightening IT budgets. Gaming operators are expanding digital platforms despite mixed earnings. Publishing and education companies are investing in AI, with mixed financial results. IT outlooks range from tightening in media to expanding in publishing and education.

industries.summary: Revenue is solid, led by Disney's $25,248 m. Companies are investing in AI and cutting costs. IT spend is mixed, with some tightening and some expansion.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong operating margin

laggards.why: Lowest disclosed revenue among listed firms

themes.title: AI & tech investment

themes.title: Cost cutting

industries.it_note: Account team should balance support for AI projects with guidance on cost‑efficiency.

industries.summary: Caesars posted $2,940 m revenue but a net loss; Bally's grew revenue sharply. Digital platform rebuilds are a focus. IT spend is expanding at Caesars but unclear elsewhere.
